key_insight: Resource-efficient Knapsack QUBO formulations improve optimal-solution success rates, with a slackless approach delivering gains of several orders of magnitude.
engineering_relevance: Careful QUBO formulation can reduce auxiliary-variable requirements and improve quantum optimization performance without changing the underlying Knapsack problem.
method: Derive a smaller penalty constant for the standard formulation.
Reduce the number of auxiliary slack variables.
Use an alternative formulation that eliminates slack variables entirely.
evidence_signal: All three approaches increased optimal-solution probabilities in LR-QAOA simulations and on a D-Wave quantum annealer; the slackless method performed best, even on relatively small instances.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether these gains persist at larger scales or translate into end-to-end speedups over classical solvers.
paper_title: Resource-efficient formulations of the Knapsack problem for quantum computing
